requirement.evidence: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
requirement.note: Exceptions for methamphetamine on federally assisted housing and lifetime sex offender registration, and applicant's right to provide evidence, are also stated in section 4.
